status: SCREENING ONLY; environmental proxies and explicitly hypothetical shadow values, not verified credits

warm_material_proxies.ferrous: Steel cans, proxy for other ferrous
warm_material_proxies.copper: Copper wire, proxy; not PCB or battery LCA

limitations: WARM credits contain recycling losses and generic transport; apply to accepted recycling input, not total waste or finished output, and do not reapply metallurgical losses to credit. Upstream proxies only, not a site-specific LCA. Site emissions deducted as a conservative extra allowance; potential overlap, capital manufacture, methane release, water and contaminant effects remain unresolved. Carbon prices, resilience values, grid and freight factors, ore grade and additionality are assumptions.
